description: Header file defining utility functions and includes for tensor operations in the ATen library, part of PyTorch. Contains functions for tensor list unwrapping, integer list checking, and tensor creation templates.

methods.name: checked_dense_tensor_list_unwrap
methods.description: Converts a list of tensors to a vector of tensor implementations, checking layout, device, and scalar type.

methods.name: check_intlist
methods.description: Checks and converts an ArrayRef of ints to a fixed-size array, filling or validating size.

methods.name: tensor_cpu
methods.description: Template function to create a CPU tensor from a list of values.

methods.name: tensor_backend
methods.description: Template function to create a tensor on a specified backend from a list of values.

methods.name: tensor_complex_cpu
methods.description: Template function to create a complex CPU tensor from a list of values.

methods.name: tensor_complex_backend
methods.description: Template function to create a complex tensor on a specified backend from a list of values.
